svg.text: One speculative decoding round for request "1"
Step N verifies d1…d5 and drafts e1…e5 · step N+1 verifies the new drafts · values are illustrative
before step N: len 50, num_tokens 49 · after: len 53, num_tokens 52 · MTP pool slot 2
What does the device do in step N? Forward, verify, then draft
One forward pass on 6 tokens. The sampler keeps d1 and d2, rejects d3, and DFlash drafts from there.
inputs t d1 d2 d3 d4 d5
What happens to the rejected d3, d4, d5? Nothing is copied back
Every store is indexed by position. The next step writes the same positions again.
slots of 52-54 hold rejected keys; step N+1 writes 52 … 57 over them
an entry at a rejected position is written again for the real token
main keys of 52-54 are overwritten by the draft keys of 52-56, in step N
d1 … d5 replaced by e1 … e5 (same slot)
tries the drafts to build masks, then rolls back
How long is the check in step N+1? 6 tokens, or fewer with DSpark
Without DSpark the request sends r and all 5 drafts. With DSpark the confidences can cut the list.
The DSpark length comes from all requests of the batch together (concepts/dspark); the cut at 3 drafts is an example.
